description: Defines the OpenClawChatTransport protocol, related enums, and default extension implementations for chat transport functionalities in a chat UI module.

classes.name: OpenClawChatTransport
classes.description: Protocol defining chat transport operations such as requesting history, sending messages, and managing sessions.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for a given session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with optional attachments in a chat session.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists chat sessions with an optional limit.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Sets the model for a session.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Sets the thinking level for a session.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Requests health status with a timeout.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns a stream of chat transport events.
